name: shared-spaces-sandbox
description: Test shared memories, private access, and revocation with synthetic sandbox accounts.

interface.longDescription: A separate connection to the Shared Memory Railway sandbox. Use Alice, Bob, and Eve test accounts to try private memories, selected sharing, corrections, and revoked access. Includes a guided test workflow. Production memories are in a separate service and identity system.
defaultPrompt: Verify my sandbox account and guide me through the shared-spaces test. Do not write until I ask.
As signed-in Alice, save a synthetic demo update and share it only in Shared Spaces Sandbox.
Verify I am Bob, then recall Alice's shared Sandbox Demo updates.
